payload.claim: The 'No retired_first' paragraph calls SA-0415 'the one queued spec' and uses that framing to justify omitting retired_first. At the base commit, SA-0415 has already been built, reviewed, and retired to .saffron/specs/done/ (it is absent from the active specs/ directory and present in specs/done/, and NEGATION_WORDS already exists in saffron/intake.py). There are now two active queued specs (SA-0416 itself and SA-0417), not one. The underlying conclusion (no retired_first needed) still holds, since SA-0415's code is already merged rather than merely queued, so this is narrative staleness from the gap between when the spec was authored (Nov 18) and the base commit it runs against (Nov 20), not a defect that changes any criterion or creates a race.
